instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Get the public key browsers need to register for notices", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:my-browser-push-application-key and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Returns only the base64url P-256 public applicationServerKey derived from the web_push field of the held notification-signing-keys bundle.
